# Lemonsky USD, Animation Export

This tool helps artists export animated geometries to USD files.

# Interface / Controls

![][image1]

## Controls

1. Frame Range \- Syncs with the scene frame range. (only updates when the tool restarts.)  
2. Export as Binary \- 99% of the time, export as binary should be checked. Unless instructed to have it checked off. 

## Scene Assets for Export

1.  Found assets in the scene.   
2. Append Selection.  
     
   USAGE:  
     
   ![][image2]  
     
1. Besides the “Append Selection ” button, users can drag and drop more assets if needed. Only allowed assets under Geometry to be added. Interface restricts unlisted assets.   
2. Users can delete assets that are not needed for export by hitting the DELETE button.

## Export

1. Export \- Export button to run the export process.
